title: Define deployment contracts and measurable rollback/traffic-throttle acceptance criteria from incident actions
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Translate actionable items from the 2026-01-28 regional autoscale/coldstart incident into concrete PRD updates that create deployable deployment contracts and verifiable acceptance criteria. This ticket scopes the product requirements and acceptance gates for: (1) an automated rollback and progressive-throttle contract that can be attached to model deployments; (2) observability and alerting required to validate contract triggers; (3) tabletop-tested runbooks and synthetic verification to prove behavior; and (4) identification of owner/roles for execution during incidents. The goal is to prevent ambiguity between SRE, Runtime, and Product on 'what constitutes a valid rollback' and to ensure future incidents can be mitigated with deterministic, measurable actions.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Deployment contract spec document created and reviewed that defines rollback/scale-down triggers, required metrics (error rate, p50/p95 latency, queue length), and exact thresholds for automatic and manual rollback.
A2: Observable signals and dashboards enumerated (metric names, tags, thresholds) and a Grafana dashboard template committed to runtime-monitoring repo.

A3: Automated rollback action implemented as an API contract (runtime endpoint + Console control) with an integration test proving rollback completes within 90 seconds of trigger under synthetic load.
A4: Progressive throttling policy defined (burst cap, steady cap, ramp-down schedule) and an e2e test validating request routing behavior when policy is applied.
A5: Runbook updated and validated by two tabletop exercises with SRE and Product; exercise notes captured as acceptance artifacts.
A6: Post-change verification: synthetic traffic script and alert smoke test committed; CI job runs verification against staging before rollout.
A7: Roles and escalation matrix documented (on-call, runtime-owner, product-owner, customer-success) and stored in the incident playbooks folder.
A8: UX copy and Console controls for manual override and audit trail present and approved by Design and Security before release.
A9: Security review required and completed for the rollback API and audit logging (KMS/HSM implications noted).
tasks: T1: Runbook action items mapping - convert each postmortem step into a requirement entry and owner assignment
T2: Draft deployment contract spec (JSON schema + human-readable guidance) and circulate to Runtime/SRE/Console teams
T3: Define metric names and create dashboard wireframes; implement Grafana template PR
T4: Implement rollback API stub and a Console toggle for manual rollback; add audit logging
T5: Implement progressive throttling policy in routing layer and add unit/integration tests
T6: Create synthetic verification scripts and CI job to run smoke tests against staging
T7: Conduct two tabletop runbook exercises and capture remediation time and gaps
T8: Finalize PRD language and acceptance criteria; secure sign-off from SRE, Runtime Engineering, Design, and Security
T9: Schedule rollout window and post-deploy verification checklist
